claim: Native GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 independently reviewed the same bounded twelve-fact architecture packet, returned structurally checked source-ID-linked critiques without model tool calls, and their usage reconciled to local monitoring.

commands.scope: Existing official SDK bridge; fresh native account/model readiness passed before inference.
Native Claude CLI with no exposed tools and ordinary native account access.

limitations: The models reviewed supplied evidence and did not independently inspect primary sources. Their critiques are advisory and were adjudicated; agreement does not establish correctness or trading performance.
This is a native architecture-review task, not another LEAN/Dagu backtest run, full MCP/RAG acceptance, broker integration, hosted deployment or universal SOTA census.
The44,214 combined native reported tokens exclude coordinator and source-research workers. They are usage, not causal tokens saved or a billing measurement across identical tokenizers.
Astra cached input is included in input and reasoning output in output. Claude thinking is included in output; duplicate per-model/iteration/stream views are not added again.
Native model selection and terminal usage are not independent provider attestation. Full account/session/process identifiers and raw event streams remain private.
The offline Alpaca observation detects synthetic field loss only; no client/network/order, valid advanced-order fixture, entitlement or execution adapter was tested.
New machines must reproduce their own selected native profile and sign-in; these local WSL receipts do not establish macOS or unattended-host acceptance.
